purpose: Dated pre-allocation repository and evidence-state checkpoint before the planned 2026-08-28 funding event. This file records only states already evidenced at this checkpoint and does not predict the Friday outcome.

repository.releaseBoundary: The tagged release remains v0.3.2. baselineCommit contains unreleased development changes and must not be described as behavior of v0.3.2.

machineObservedBlockers: required-strata-unresolved: hard-eligibility (coverage or evidence-availability disposition required)
empiricalCorpus.source: scripts/study_status.py output in validation run 442 on baselineCommit

simocracyEvidence.freshnessBoundary: This checkpoint carries forward the separately dated 2026-08-24 funding-status snapshot. It does not claim that the Simocracy surface was independently re-observed on 2026-08-25.

fridayCaptureRule.rule: After an authoritative Friday artifact exists, add a new dated snapshot. Preserve the authoritative platform decision vocabulary and record payment authorization, transfer, receipt, or settlement only when separately evidenced. Do not rewrite this checkpoint or the 2026-08-24 snapshot to imply continuity or a stronger financial state.

nonClaims: This checkpoint does not predict or represent the outcome of the planned 2026-08-28 funding event.
A successful repository validation run does not establish substantive correctness, fairness, institutional legitimacy, or external adoption.
The empirical corpus is not complete and is not represented as statistically representative of ENS decisions.
The unresolved hard-eligibility stratum does not establish that supporting evidence does not exist; it means no evidence-backed checked-in case covers that stratum at this checkpoint.
The recorded $219 allocation state is not represented as payment, transfer, receipt, or settlement.
Null financial-evidence fields mean the referenced dated snapshot contains no such evidence; they do not prove the event did not occur elsewhere.
